title: Learner profile sheet
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 91 (Learner profile sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 91: Myself as a learner: describing who I am. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Strength
Evidence example
rows: I always ask why in science
I redrafted my story three times
I help my partner in breakout rooms

parts.text: Strength + evidence: I am curious: in science I asked so many questions about genes that I researched Mendel at home.
Second strength: I am resilient: my Pompeii story took three drafts.
Honest challenge: I still rush my proofreading.
Growth: I have learned that slow checking saves time later.

keywords.def: thinking carefully about your own experiences

questions.a: For example: I am organised: I always plan my writing in a grid.

questions.q: Core: write a reflective description of yourself as a learner: two strengths and one challenge, with evidence
Extend: use a metaphor for yourself as a learner
questions.a: For example: I am a seed that needed patience.

questions.q: Stretch: link your challenge to a plan for Year 7
questions.a: For example: In Year 7 I will proofread every piece twice.

questions.q: Which sentence gives the best evidence for 'I am resilient'?
options: I redrafted my report three times until it was clear.
questions.a: A) I redrafted my report three times until it was clear.. It describes a real action that shows resilience.
